name: academic-publication-tracker
description: An open-source desktop workspace for scholarly discovery and transparent citation metrics.
author: Academic Publication Tracker contributors

scripts.build: tsc --noEmit && vite build && node scripts/build-electron.mjs && node scripts/generate-licenses.mjs
scripts.dist:mac: npm run build && electron-builder --mac --config electron-builder.preview.yml --publish never && node scripts/verify-mac-signatures.mjs
scripts.dist:mac:signed: npm run build && electron-builder --mac --publish never && node scripts/verify-mac-signatures.mjs --distribution
